title: SOS: trust-store silent-drop gate untested
description: Found by codereview (edge pass) on b7z9.121.3. emergency.py trust_store.verify_or_pin 失败->静默丢弃的分支(~L268)无测试;套件中没有任何 SosResource(trust_store=...) 构造。补 TOFU pin 失败->静默丢弃 + 首次有效签名->pin 成功两个用例。
close_reason: Added TestSosTrustStoreGate to python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py covering the previously untrusted trust_store gate (emergency.py:268-272): (1) first valid signature -> CHANGED + activated + TOFU pin (pubkey bytes + level asserted); (2) matching pinned peer re-accepted on advancing sequence; (3) forged POST pins nothing (pin-after-verify ordering pinned); (4) pin-conflict (valid sig, wrong pinned key) -> silent drop + no activation. 115/115 tests pass, ruff clean. 3x codereview via kimi-k3 (correctness/security/edge): findings folded in - strengthened pin assertion, fixed misleading BR-anchor comment, added re-accept + forged-pin tests; RevokedPeerError coverage filed as follow-up P3 bead.
